title: 第四章　权利的世界

zh: 和平时期的外汇管制按国际法应被视为侵略行为，也是对人权的侵犯。
en: Exchange control in time of peace should be considered an act of aggression and a violation of human rights in international law.

zh: ——菲利普·科特尼，1949年
en: —Philip Cortney, 1949

zh: 在《通往奴役之路》（
）——这部1944年出版、令他声名大噪的著作——的中段，F. A. 哈耶克插入了一段关于人权的评论。他针对的是作家兼公共知识分子H. G. 威尔斯（H. G. Wells）1939年发表的那份包罗万象的《权利宣言》（Declaration of Rights），那是一份包含十一条内容的清单，其中包括接受教育、获得食物和医疗服务以及就业的权利。
哈耶克对那些物质性条款的反对并不强烈。他自己的主张里也包含基本社会安全网的要素，甚至包括逆周期的政府支出。
正如自由至上主义者后来所哀叹的那样，《通往奴役之路》呼吁提供“最低收入的保障”和“一套全面的社会保险制度”。
真正令哈耶克恼火的是威尔斯把权利话语与一套中央化的经济决策纲领结合在一起。在哈耶克看来，权利话语无法与国家对生产和劳动的指挥并行不悖。倘若“共同福利”一类含糊的范畴可以压倒一个人的职业选择，那么个人权利就不可能存在。
哈耶克捍卫个人权利的话语，但仅限于这些权利是消极权利：即按照自己的意愿在不同地方移动劳动与资本的自由。其理据与其说基于自然法，不如说基于功利主义：由竞争引导的个人选择将解开市场复杂性之谜，并确保最佳可能的分工与资源配置。
en: Midway through

the book he published in 1944 that made him famous, F. A. Hayek inserted a commentary on human rights. His target was specifically the expansive “Declaration of Rights” published by the author and public intellectual H. G. Wells in 1939, a list of eleven articles including the right to education, food, health care, and employment.
Hayek did not object so much to the material provisions. His own proposal included elements of a basic social safety net and even countercyclical state spending.
As libertarians later lamented,
called for “the security of a minimum income” and “a comprehensive system of social insurance.”

What galled Hayek was Wells’s combination of the language of rights with a program of centralized economic decision making. For Hayek, rights talk could not work alongside state direction of production and labor. If nebulous categories like “the common welfare” could override one’s choice of employment, then individual rights could not exist.

Hayek defended the language of individual rights, but only insofar as those rights were negative: the freedom to move one’s labor and capital where one saw fit. The rationale was based less on natural law than on utilitarianism: individual choices guided by competition would solve the riddle of the complexity of the market and ensure the best possible division of labor and allocation of resources.

zh: 哈耶克与威尔斯在1930年代的英国活跃于同一圈子——那是一个感到有义务重新思考战后世界根基的学术与文化精英群体。在哈耶克、米塞斯、汉斯·凯尔森（Hans Kelsen）、赫施·劳特帕赫特（Hersch Lauterpacht）等奥地利精英与约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯、莱昂内尔·罗宾斯、埃德温·坎南（Edwin Cannan）、詹姆斯·米德（James Meade）等英国精英之间，存在一种共同的使命感：前者曾受训服务于一个如今已逝的帝国，后者则寻求改革一个仍然存续的帝国。彼此的联系十分紧密。威尔斯那份宣言的起草者之一，就是哈耶克的朋友、他在联邦同盟（Federal Union）经济学家委员会上的同事芭芭拉·伍顿（Barbara Wootton）；她本人的文章就刊印在哈耶克那篇如今著名的1939年文章讨论“国家间联邦制”（inter-state federalism）之后，同载于《新联邦季刊》（New Commonwealth Quarterly）。
威尔斯自己也在这份期刊上发表文章。
在战前和战争年代的岁月里，哈耶克参与了西方公共知识分子的一项广泛努力，即构想威尔斯1940年所称的、将随全球冲突而来的“新世界秩序”（The New World Order）。
1947年，当哈耶克在瑞士召集一群知识分子成立朝圣山学社、开启战后新自由主义知识运动时，他秉持的正是这种富有远见的全球主义精神。
en: Hayek and Wells moved in the same circles in 1930s Britain—an academic and cultural elite that felt obliged to rethink the foundations of a postwar world. There was a shared sense of duty among Austrian elites like Hayek, Mises, Hans Kelsen, and Hersch Lauterpacht, who had trained to serve what was now a vanished empire, and British elites like John Maynard Keynes, Lionel Robbins, Edwin Cannan, and James Meade, who were seeking to reform a still-living one. The connections were close. One of the drafters of Wells’s declaration was Hayek’s friend and colleague on the Federal Union’s economists committee Barbara Wootton, whose own article followed his now-famous 1939 article on “inter-state federalism” in the
Wells published in the same journal himself.

In the years before and during the war, Hayek participated in the broad effort of public intellectuals in the West to conceptualize what Wells called in 1940 “The New World Order” that would follow global conflict.

When in 1947 Hayek convened a group of intellectuals in Switzerland to form the Mont Pèlerin Society and initiate the postwar neoliberal intellectual movement, he was operating in this same spirit of visionary globalism.

zh: 尽管学者们常常指出哈耶克在其规范性国家秩序中纳入了安全网，他们却未能把目光投向国家之外——或国家之上。
正如我们在第3章所见，哈耶克在《通往奴役之路》结尾提出的世界秩序蓝图，把国际联邦规定为不断扩张的福利国家的解药，而非补充。他的国家层面愿景让国家义务与消极权利保持平衡，但他的全球秩序却只专注于后者。他写道，国际机构“首先必须能说‘不’”：对商品、资本和人员流动的障碍说不，因而也就对保护幼稚工业、为增加国家支出而加税、隔绝劳动力市场等做法说不。
耐人寻味的是，哈耶克援引的两项对个人权利的侵犯都与跨国关系有关。第一项是中欧地区对企业财产的征收，那里的业主在分崩离析的哈布斯堡帝国继承国中突然沦为被视为外来者的“少数民族”。
第二项是对货币从一种通货兑换为另一种通货并跨境运送的管制；他以令人意外的激烈措辞称之为“朝着极权主义和压制个人自由之路迈出的决定性一步”。
en: Although scholars routinely note Hayek’s inclusion of a safety net in his normative national order, they fail to cast their gaze beyond—or above—the nation.
As we saw in Chapter 3, Hayek’s blueprint for world order at the end of

prescribed international federation as an antidote, not a complement, to the expanding welfare state. His national vision balanced state duties with negative rights, but his global order concentrated exclusively on the latter. The powers of an international authority, he wrote, “must above all be able to say ‘no’ ”: no to obstacles to the movement of goods, capital, and people, and, thus, no to protections for infant industries, increased taxation for state spending, and insulation of labor markets.

It is telling that the two transgressions of individual rights that Hayek cites are both related to transnational relations. The first was the expropriation of businesses in Central Europe, where owners suddenly became foreign “minorities” in the successor nations of the crumbled Habsburg Empire.

The second was the control of the exchange of money from one currency into another and its transport over borders, which he called, with surprising vehemence, “the decisive advance on the path to totalitarianism and the suppression of individual liberty.”

zh: 哈耶克的消极权利话语和“说不”的权力，可能给人一种错误印象，似乎他的规范性全球秩序设想的是一个被动或不作为的国家。然而，创设并维护这样一种安排需要积极主动的投入。哈耶克本人就明确表示，国际权力需要“一种能够执行〔这些〕规则的权威”。
尽管战后哈耶克转向，不再关注国际秩序，其他新自由主义者却没有。正如我们将看到的，新自由主义者反对在基本的消极权利清单中纳入社会权利与经济权利，与此同时却为他们自己的经济权利辩护——首先是保障外国投资安全的权利，以及让资本自由跨境流动的权利。与哈耶克一样，他们把针对外资财产的征收和资本流动管制视为对权利最根本的侵犯。他们还将参与设计制度，以保障免于征收和免于资本管制的“消极权利”。
en: Hayek’s language of negative rights and the power to say no can give a false impression of a passive or inactive state in his normative global order. Yet creating and securing such an arrangement required proactive engagement. Hayek himself was explicit that the international power needed “an authority capable of enforcing [the] rules.”

Although after the war Hayek swerved away from engagement with international order, other neoliberals did not. As we will see, neoliberals argued against adding social and economic rights to the basic list of negative rights, even as they made the case for economic rights of their own—above all, the right to keep foreign investment safe and to move capital freely over borders. Like Hayek, they focused on the expropriation of foreign-owned property and controls on capital movements as being the central violations of rights. They would help design institutions that would safeguard the “negative rights” of freedom from expropriation and capital control.

zh: 为了描述新自由主义者所倡导的那种特殊权利形式，我借用哈耶克的一个术语，称之为“异邦人权”（xenos rights）。在最后一部出版的著作中，哈耶克谈到早期希腊历史上的xenos，即“guest-friend”（客友），“他获有保障，可在异邦领土内以个人身份进入并受到保护”。哈耶克认为，这一做法意味着“贸易在很大程度上必定是作为个人关系发展起来的”。
他在别处写道：“需要这样的规则，它们使人能够在每一时刻确定每个人受保护领域的边界，从而区分
〔属于我的东西〕与
〔属于你的东西〕。”
异邦人权这一范畴有助于我们思考：个人无论身处何领土，都享有受保护的平安通行权，以及其财产与资本不受侵犯的所有权。这是一项内在于dominium（所有权）的统一经济空间、而非imperium（统治权）的被分割为各国的空间的权利——但它需要imperium的政治制度来加以保障。
en: To describe the particular form of rights promoted by neoliberals, I call them “xenos rights,” borrowing a term from Hayek. In his last published work, Hayek spoke of the xenos, or guest-friend, in early Greek history, “who was assured individual admission and protection within an alien territory.” Hayek suggests that this practice meant that “trade must have developed very much as a matter of personal relations.”
Elsewhere he wrote that “rules are required which make it possible at each moment to ascertain the boundary of the protected domain of each and thus to distinguish between the
[that which is mine] and the
[that which is yours].”

The category of xenos rights helps us think about individuals having protected rights to safe passage and unmolested ownership of their property and capital, regardless of the territory. It is a right that inheres to the unitary economic space of dominium rather than the fragmented state space of imperium—yet it requires the political institutions of imperium to ensure it.

zh: 对新自由主义者而言，战后时期的问题与第一次世界大战后困扰各国的问题如出一辙：民主的无约束扩张。1932年，秩序自由主义者瓦尔特·欧肯谴责“世界的民主化”。他指的是工业化国家中的普选（成年男子普选权），它把“人民及其激情、利益集团和群氓的混乱力量”带进了政治。
1945年之后的时代把威廉·勒普克（Röpke）所称的“rabies democratica”（民主狂犬病）蔓延到全球。
当第一批殖民地摆脱其帝国宗主获得独立时，国际机构——尤其是联合国——成了提出政治主张的场所。

随着一人一票变成一国一票，全球南方国家在恰恰是那些新自由主义者1930年代曾与之交锋的社会民主派经济学家中找到了代言人。哈伯勒和亚历山大·洛夫戴（Alexander Loveday）等自由主义者曾为早期的国际联盟定下基调，但主导年轻的联合国的，却是瑞典人贡纳尔·缪尔达尔（Gunnar Myrdal）、匈牙利人尼古拉斯·卡尔多（Nicholas Kaldor）和托马斯·巴洛格（Thomas Balogh）这样的社会民主派。“发展”这一新话语以及“发展经济学”这一分支学科，使各地要求实现充分就业、实行资本管制及有权把外国人所有的资产和资源国有化的主张更具正当性。正如勒普克讥讽所言：“联合国所构拟的今日‘人权’，包括一个国家征收一座发电厂的神圣权利。”
en: To neoliberals, the problem of the postwar period was the same problem that plagued states after the First World War: the unconstrained expansion of democracy. In 1932 ordoliberal Walter Eucken denounced “the democratization of the world.” By this he meant the universal male suffrage in industrialized nations that brought “the people and their passions, the interest groups and chaotic powers of the masses” into politics.
The post-1945 era spread what Wilhelm Röpke called the “rabies democratica” globally.
As the first colonies gained independence from their imperial masters, the international institutions, and the United Nations in particular, became spaces for political claims-making.

As one-person-one-vote became one-country-one-vote, Global South nations found spokespeople among the very social democratic economists that the neoliberals had clashed with in the 1930s. Liberals like Haberler and Alexander Loveday had set the tone at the early League of Nations, but it was social democrats like the Swedish Gunnar Myrdal and the Hungarians Nicholas Kaldor and Thomas Balogh who dominated the young UN. The new language of “development” and the subfield of “development economics” helped legitimize worldwide demands for full employment, capital controls, and the right to nationalize foreign-owned assets and resources. As Röpke put it sarcastically, “today’s ‘human rights’ as formulated by the UN include the sacred right of a state to expropriate a power plant.”

zh: 战后初期的新自由主义者觉得自己赢得了战争，却正在输掉和平。1947年，当他们聚集在朝圣山盘点形势、商讨策略时，哈耶克建议他们效仿社会主义者的榜样。费边社一类的左翼人士——其中一些他曾与他们在联邦同盟以及费边社创办的伦敦政治经济学院共事——成功地随时间推移改变了论辩，从而同时俘获了公众舆论与公共权力，把自己的愿景变成了现实。学者们已经注意到，战后正是基于这种对观念力量的认识，新自由主义者开始了一场“长期阵地战”。
en: Neoliberals in the early postwar years felt that they had won the war but were losing the peace. When they gathered to take stock and talk strategies in Mont Pèlerin in 1947, Hayek suggested that they follow the example of socialists. Leftists like the Fabians, some of whom he had cooperated with in the Federal Union and as a professor at the Fabian-founded London School of Economics, had succeeded in shifting debates over time, thus capturing both public opinion and public power and making their vision reality. Scholars have noted how neoliberals began a “long-run war of position” on this understanding of the power of ideas in the postwar moment.

zh: 尽管准备投入长期斗争，新自由主义者同时也进行着较短期的“运动战”。本章聚焦于一桩具体而鲜为人知的案例：新自由主义知识分子在帮助击败国际贸易组织（ITO）——这个本应完善布雷顿森林体系的机构——过程中所扮演的角色，以及他们在起草战后国际投资法初稿中所起的作用。关键人物是迈克尔·海尔佩林、菲利普·科特尼和路德维希·艾哈德（Ludwig Erhard）。日内瓦学派的新自由主义者提出了他们自己的权利世界愿景。针对人权，他们针锋相对地提出资本的人权。针对无国籍者，他们针锋相对地提出投资者。针对主权与自主，他们针锋相对地提出世界经济与国际分工。他们的“国民”既是个人，也是公司。作为企业界两个最大利益集团的代言人，海尔佩林和科特尼阐发了一种论战性的、替代性的人权愿景，为国际法创造了持久的先例，并把哈耶克1949年对自由主义乌托邦的要求变成了现实。
en: Even as they dug in for the long struggle, neoliberals also engaged in shorter-term “wars of movement.” This chapter zeroes in on a specific, little-known case of the role of neoliberal intellectuals in helping to defeat the International Trade Organization (ITO), the institution that was intended to complete the Bretton Woods system, as well as their role in writing first drafts for postwar international investment law. The key players were Michael Heilperin, Philip Cortney, and Ludwig Erhard. Geneva School neoliberals proposed their own vision of a world of rights. Against human rights, they posed the human rights of capital. Against the stateless person, they posed the investor. Against sovereignty and autonomy, they posed the world economy and the international division of labor. Their “national” was both a person and a company. As the mouthpieces of big business’s two largest interest groups, Heilperin and Cortney articulated a polemical, alternative vision of human rights, created lasting precedent for international law, and made concrete Hayek’s 1949 demand for a liberal utopia.

zh: 经济民主的危险

布雷顿森林机构生来就不完整。国际货币基金组织（IMF）负责管理国际货币事务。它通过向陷入困境的国家提供短期贷款、允许国家在必要时调整汇率，帮助维持币值稳定。世界银行负责重建与发展。它提供低息长期贷款和贷款担保，帮助建设基础设施与工业能力，先是西欧，然后是全球南方。缺少的是一个负责监督贸易的机构。拟填补这一角色的实体是ITO，它将凑齐布雷顿森林三驾马车。与国际货币基金组织和世界银行一样，它将设在联合国体系内，并为国际自由贸易提供法律框架。这一设想由美国于1945年率先提出；1946年2月，联合国经济及社会理事会（ECOSOC，经社理事会）作出决议，召开一次贸易与就业问题国际会议，起草一份世界贸易宪章。
en: The Bretton Woods institutions were born incomplete. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) was responsible for the world’s money. It helped keep currency values stable by making short-term loans to nations in trouble, and allowing states to adjust their exchange rates when necessary. The World Bank was responsible for reconstruction and development. It made low-interest, long-term loans and loan guarantees to help build infrastructure and industrial capacity, first in Western Europe and then in the Global South. What was missing was a body responsible for overseeing trade. The entity planned to fill this role was the ITO, which would complete the Bretton Woods trio. Like the IMF and the World Bank, it would be housed in the UN and provide a legal framework for international free trade. First proposed by the United States in 1945, the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) resolved in February 1946 to convene an international conference on trade and employment to draft a charter on world trade.

zh: 宪章最初的起草方将由十五个主要全球北方国家加上印度和中国组成。这种决策权的分配或许反映了各国在世界贸易中的相对份额，但考虑到1946年世界已有七十一个独立国家，它远远谈不上有代表性。这样有限的民主原则，将复制联合国治理的两层结构——在联合国，小小的安全理事会对于庞大的大会拥有否决权。它还将沿袭国际货币基金组织和世界银行的做法，即投票权按各国在世界贸易中所占份额分配。在联合国的推动下，ITO的筹备小组不断扩容，先加入了智利、黎巴嫩和挪威，随后又有其他国家加入。
参加三次会议——1946年伦敦、1947年日内瓦、1948年哈瓦那——谈判的国家数目还要多。全球南方国家的加入最终产生了重大影响，因为拉丁美洲和亚洲的代表把议程从自由贸易正统上推开。这些国家并不否定国际贸易的价值，但寻求确立一项平行权利：为了保护幼稚工业免受外国竞争、追求国内发展与充分就业，可以偏离自由贸易的正统规则。
en: The original authors of the charter were to be a group of fifteen of the major Global North nations with the addition of India and China. This allocation of decision-making power may have reflected the relative share of trade in the world economy, but it was less than representative, considering that the world contained seventy-one independent countries by 1946. Such a limited democratic principle would have reproduced the two-tier nature of governance in the UN, where a small Security Council had veto power over a large General Assembly. It would have also followed the model of the IMF and the World Bank, where votes were proportionate to a nation’s share of world trade. Nudged by the UN, the ITO planning group expanded over time, adding first Chile, Lebanon, and Norway, and then others.

The number of nations involved in negotiations at the three meetings—in London in 1946, Geneva in 1947 and Havana in 1948—was even larger. The addition of Global South nations ended up being momentous, because Latin American and Asian delegates pushed the agenda away from free-trade orthodoxy. Without discrediting the value of international trade, these nations sought to enshrine a parallel right to deviate from the orthodox rules of free trade to protect nascent industries against foreign competition and to pursue domestic development and full employment.

zh: 民主原则在ITO筹备过程中的扩展，是反抗国际联盟与国际商会（ICC）在1927年世界经济会议上表达的相通设想的一刻。消极整合的简单原则不再主宰一切。关税壁垒既可以拆除，也可以用来保护正在成长的幼稚工业。ITO的美国首席谈判代表回忆起来自“不发达国家”的“一致的谴责声”，这些国家以发展需要特殊待遇为名，反对整齐一律的原则。
最重要的体现是在表决原则上。与国际货币基金组织和世界银行不同，ITO将按一国一票原则组织。民主将被带入全球经济治理的舞台。
en: The expansion of the democratic principle in the planning of the ITO was a moment of revolt against the twinned imaginaries of the League of Nations and the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) as expressed at the World Economic Conference of 1927. No longer would the simple principle of negative integration hold sway. Tariff walls did not exist only to be dismantled but to shelter aspiring infant industries. The chief U.S. negotiator at the ITO recalled a “chorus of denunciation” from the “underdeveloped nations” as they opposed uniform principles in the name of the need for special treatment in the cause of development.

The most important way this was expressed was in the governing principle. Unlike the IMF and World Bank, the ITO was to be organized on the principle of one-country-one-vote. Democracy was to be brought to the stage of global economic governance.

zh: 战后新自由主义运动诞生于ITO这场正剧上演的当口，其部分成员在剧中扮演了主角。1947年春，当各国代表在日内瓦聚会起草世界贸易宪章时，一群知识分子聚集在湖的另一端、朝圣山的山脚下。他们以这个地方命名，朝圣山学社（MPS）成了其组织者哈耶克所称“新自由主义运动”的雏形。
聚会者中有米塞斯、勒普克、罗宾斯，以及两位未来的诺贝尔纪念奖（经济学奖）得主米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）和乔治·斯蒂格勒（George Stigler）。朝圣山学社承接了1930年代“哈伯勒式的”国际合作项目，包括李普曼座谈会、讨论哈伯勒关于大萧条研究的研讨会，以及在安纳西（Annecy）举行的关于世界经济的研讨会。
en: The postwar neoliberal movement was born in the midst of the ITO drama, and some of its members played a starring role in it. As delegates met in Geneva in the spring of 1947 to draft the world trade charter, a group of intellectuals gathered at the other end of the lake at the base of Mont Pèlerin. Taking their name from the location, the Mont Pèlerin Society (MPS) became the germ of what its organizer Hayek called “the neoliberal movement.”

Among those gathered were Mises, Röpke, Robbins, and two future Nobel Memorial Prize winners, Milton Friedman and George Stigler. The MPS picked up from the “Haberler-type” international collaborative projects of the 1930s, including the Lippmann Colloquium, the workshop on Haberler’s Depression study, and the Annecy workshop on the world economy.

zh: 用哈耶克的话说，朝圣山学社的意图是促成“新自由主义倡导者之间的个人接触”，“搭建一座融贯的……新自由主义思想的宏大建筑，并针对各国的问题制定出它的实际应用方案”。这既包括个人接触，也包括关键文本的翻译与传播，以激发“新自由主义思想的流动”。
与1930年代日内瓦和巴黎的会议一样，朝圣山学社无论在其使命还是研究对象上都是全球性的。哈耶克觉得，社会主义者垄断国际主义话语已经太久。新自由主义者需要有坚持自身信念的勇气，拿出社会主义者半个世纪以来一直在做的那种胆识：梦想一个乌托邦。他们必须构想出自己想看到的世界，哪怕这看起来不切实际或难以置信。
en: In Hayek’s words, the intention of the MPS was to allow for “personal contact among the proponents of neoliberalism,” to “erect a coherent edifice of … neoliberal thought, and to work out its practical application to the problems of different countries.” This involved personal contact as well as translation and distribution of key texts to stimulate the “flow of neoliberal ideas.”

Like the meetings in Geneva and Paris in the 1930s, the MPS was global in both its mandate and its object of study. Hayek felt that socialists had too long monopolized the language of internationalism. Neoliberals needed to have the courage of their con-victions and exhibit the boldness to do what socialists had done for half a century: dream of a utopia. They must conceive of the world they wanted to see, even if that seemed impractical or implausible.

zh: 我们已经看到，1945年以前，社会主义者远谈不上垄断全球主义思想。两次世界大战之间（战间期），日内瓦的经济自由主义者——无论在国联内部还是外部——都曾怀抱宏大梦想，试图重新想象并重建他们眼中世界资本主义逝去的黄金时代。从许多方面看，朝圣山学社都是国联精神的延续。朝圣山的许多人物——包括米塞斯、勒普克、哈耶克、罗宾斯、莫里斯·阿莱（Maurice Allais）和拉帕德（Rappard）——要么曾在日内瓦工作，要么在威廉·拉帕德（William Rappard）主持的日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Graduate Institute）展示过自己的研究成果。勒普克曾计划在日内瓦组织一次会议，召集其中许多同样的人物，会期定于1939年9月——正是战争爆发的月份。朝圣山的第一次聚会，就是那场被战争推迟的国际会议的兑现。
en: We have already seen that socialists hardly held a monopoly on globalist thought before 1945. Economic liberals in Geneva both inside and outside of the League of Nations had dreamt big in the interwar period as they sought to reimagine and rebuild what they saw as the lost golden age of world capitalism. In many ways the MPS was a continuation of the League’s spirit. Many of the figures at Mont Pèlerin—including Mises, Röpke, Hayek, Robbins, Maurice Allais, and Rappard—had either worked at Geneva or presented their work at William Rappard’s Graduate Institute. Röpke had planned a meeting in Geneva to gather many of the same players for September 1939, the month the war broke out. The first gathering at Mont Pèlerin was the realization of the international meeting delayed.

zh: 考虑到这份日内瓦渊源，朝圣山学社宗旨声明持全球视野就不足为奇了。这份由罗宾斯执笔的声明开篇即指出：“在地球表面大片区域上，人的尊严与自由的基本条件已经消失。在其他一些区域，它们不断受到当前政策走向发展的威胁。”这里的所指不仅是共产主义，也包括社会民主主义的倾向，例如英国新近当选的工党政府正在掀起的国有化浪潮。声明最后呼吁研究“建立一个有助于维护和平与自由、并允许建立和谐国际经济关系的国际秩序”。
en: Given the Genevan pedigree, it is no surprise that the MPS statement of aims was global in its perspective. Penned by Robbins, it began by observing that “over large stretches of the Earth’s surface the essential conditions of human dignity and freedom have already disappeared. In others they are under constant menace from the development of current tendencies of policy.” The reference here was not only to communism but also to trends toward social democracy, such as the wave of nationalizations being carried out by the recently elected Labour Party in Britain. The statement concluded by calling for study of “the creation of an international order conducive to the safeguarding of peace and liberty and permitting the establishment of harmonious international economic relations.”

zh: 朝圣山学社声明中那些宽泛——且略显含糊——的情感和主张，在数周后得到了实质支撑：来自三十个国家的五百名商人聚集在蒙特勒，这个地方距朝圣山不足二十公里，他们召开的是战后国际商会（ICC）的第一次大会。如第1章所述，哈耶克、米塞斯、哈伯勒和马赫卢普都曾分享并在一定程度上采纳了国际商会的全球视野：整个1920年代和1930年代初，ICC就是他们的雇主；米塞斯还在战间期代表奥地利出席过不止一次ICC会议。更切近地说，首届朝圣山学社会议最大的单一资助者是瑞士实业家兼外交官汉斯·苏尔策（Hans Sulzer），他1930年代曾任ICC执行委员会理事会成员，1945年后任该会副主席之一。
苏尔策既是朝圣山学社的主要资助者之一，后来还成为其社员——并因涉嫌与纳粹贸易而被英国列入黑名单——战后他还曾设法延聘哈耶克出任苏黎世大学教授。
他还是ICC与卡内基国际和平基金会联合委员会的成员，该委员会曾在1930年代资助世界顶尖经济学家（包括米塞斯）就国际经济重建开展重大研究。
en: The broad—and somewhat vague—sentiments of the MPS statement were given substance a few weeks later when five hundred businessmen from thirty countries convened in Montreux, less than twenty kilometers from Mont Pèlerin, at the first gathering of the International Chamber of Commerce since the war. As described in Chapter 1, Hayek, Mises, Haberler, and Machlup all shared and partially adopted their global perspective from the ICC, which had been their employer through the 1920s and early 1930s; Mises had represented Austria at more than one ICC meeting in the interwar period. More proximately, the biggest single funder of the first MPS meeting was the Swiss industrialist and diplomat Hans Sulzer, who was a member of council of the ICC’s executive committee in the 1930s and one of its vice presidents after 1945.

A main financial supporter of the MPS and later a member—and black-listed by the British for alleged trade with the Nazis—Sulzer helped try to hire Hayek for a chair at the University of Zurich after the war.

He was also a member of the Joint Committee of the ICC and Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, which had sponsored major research by the world’s leading economists (including Mises) on international economic reconstruction in the 1930s.

zh: 如果说新自由主义知识分子在山顶上布道，ICC就是他们的大本营。在蒙特勒，三十八岁的波兰裔美国经济学家迈克尔·安杰洛·海尔佩林（Michael Angelo Heilperin）——他是一名朝圣山学社社员，日后将在1960年代的货币辩论中扮演重要角色——向与会商界人士提交了国际商会对国际贸易组织《哈瓦那宪章》的正式分析。海尔佩林是日内瓦学派的典型成员。他1909年生于华沙，1929年和1931年在日内瓦大学先后取得本科和研究生学位。他的博士论文（用法文写成）论述哈布斯堡帝国崩溃所产生的货币问题。1934年，他曾引起洛克菲勒基金会的浓厚兴趣，考虑资助在日内瓦设立一个国际货币研究所。
作为拉帕德的学生，海尔佩林1935年在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Graduate Institute for International Studies）谋得职位，比米塞斯晚一年。
有三年时间，他与米塞斯“几乎每日接触”，也与1937年抵达该院的勒普克共事。
1938年，海尔佩林在李普曼座谈会上就货币问题发言。
战后，他既是朝圣山学社直言不讳的成员，又是《财富》（
）杂志的副主编，还参加过比尔德贝格会议，以及在促成终结汇率固定但可调整的布雷顿森林体系方面发挥作用的贝拉焦小组（Bellagio Group）会议。
en: If the neoliberal intellectuals spoke from the mountaintop, the ICC was its base. At Montreux, the thirty-eight-year-old Polish American economist Michael Angelo Heilperin, an MPS member who would play a major role in monetary debates of the 1960s, presented the official analysis of the ITO Havana Charter to the gathered businesspeople. Heilperin was a quintessential member of the Geneva School. Born in Warsaw in 1909, he completed his undergraduate and graduate degrees at the University of Geneva, in 1929 and 1931. His dissertation (written in French) was on the monetary problems produced by the collapse of the Habsburg Empire. In 1934 he had generated serious interest from the Rockefeller Foundation to fund the creation of an International Monetary Institute in Geneva.
A student of Rappard’s, Heilperin took a position at Geneva’s Graduate Institute for International Studies in 1935, a year after Mises.
For three years he worked “in almost daily contact” with Mises and also alongside Röpke, who arrived at the institute in 1937.
Heilperin presented on monetary issues at the Lippmann Colloquium in 1938.
He was a vocal member of the MPS after the war as well as an associate editor of
magazine, a participant in Bilderberg meetings and in the Bellagio Group meetings that helped end the Bretton Woods system of fixed but adjustable exchange rates.

zh: 海尔佩林与国际商界圈子的初次接触是在1943年：他从汉密尔顿学院的职位上休假，出任制药与化妆品公司布里斯托-梅耶尔斯（Bristol-Meyers）的顾问；该公司以泻药和牙膏为旗舰产品，并在战争期间拿下为盟军士兵供应青霉素的大合同。
在1944年的国际商务会议上——把ICC、全国制造商协会（National Association of Manufacturers）等聚到一起的会议——海尔佩林担任国际货币关系部分的报告员。
ICC在联合国经社理事会享有最高协商地位，参与了创建ITO努力的每一个阶段。
作为ICC顾问，海尔佩林是为数不多以非官方身份同时出席日内瓦和哈瓦那两次会议的美国人之一。
1950年，布里斯托-梅耶尔斯公司总裁李·H. 布里斯托（Lee H. Bristol）出面反对哈瓦那宪章，在国会作证时带上了海尔佩林，全部取材于他的分析，并在会上遇到自己答不上来的细节时听从海尔佩林补充。
en: Heilperin first became involved with international business circles in 1943, when he took a leave of absence from his position at Hamilton College to work as an adviser for the pharmaceutical and cosmetics company Bristol-Meyers, which had flagship products in laxatives and toothpastes and secured a major contract to supply penicillin to Allied soldiers during the war.

At the 1944 International Business Conference, which brought together the ICC, the National Association of Manufacturers, and others, Heilperin was the rapporteur for the section on international monetary relations.
Enjoying the highest consultative status on the UN Economic and Social Council, the ICC was a participant at every stage of the attempt to create the ITO.
As the ICC adviser, Heilperin was one of the few Americans attending both the Geneva and Havana conferences in an unofficial capacity.

When the president of Bristol-Myers, Lee H. Bristol, appeared before the U.S. Congress in 1950 to reject the ITO charter, he brought Heilperin along, drew exclusively from his analysis, and deferred to him during the session for details that he was unable to provide.

zh: 海尔佩林在蒙特勒提出的反对哈瓦那宪章的声明，几乎与国际商会和国联在1927年世界经济会议上的立场一字不易——按照海尔佩林的说法，那次会议“是国际努力的顶点”，产生了“同类报告中最全面、说理最周延的文件”，可惜不包括任何强制执行或作出承诺的机制。
与1927年的报告一样，海尔佩林要求消极整合。为了“全世界范围内生产力、贸易、投资和生活水平的整体增长”，需要一个这样的体系：“货物、资本和人员能够在各国间尽可能自由地流动，服务也能尽可能自由地交换。”
en: Heilperin’s statement of opposition to the Havana Charter at Montreux was a near carbon copy of the position of the ICC and the League of Nations at the World Economic Conference of 1927—an event that, according to Heilperin, was “the high point of international endeavor” and produced “the most comprehensive report of its kind, a well-reasoned document” but, regrettably, included no mechanism for enforcement or commitment.
Like the 1927 report, Heilperin demanded negative integration. For the “overall growth of productivity, trade, investment, and living standards
” a system was needed “in which goods, capital, and men can move and services be exchanged with the greatest possible freedom from country to country.”

zh: 海尔佩林谴责拟议中的ITO，用的是1930年代的批判语汇：“经济民族主义。”在他看来，哈瓦那宪章中的例外条款、紧急条款和选择退出条款之多，使之成为“文明世界漫长历史上写成的第一份经济民族主义国际宪章”。
对海尔佩林和ICC而言，ITO宪章是一份“危险的文件”，最危险之处在于它把民主移植进了国际关系。布里斯托在美国国会发言称，“一国一票的表决程序是不可接受的”。它有可能造成一种局面：“国际贸易的规则将由一大批在国际贸易中利害关系较小、往往也几乎没有实施贸易政策经验的国家来制定。”
en: Heilperin condemned the proposed ITO, using the term of critique from the 1930s: “economic nationalism.” According to Heilperin, the number of exceptions, emergency clauses, and opt-outs in the Havana Charter had made it “the first international charter of economic nationalism ever written in the long history of the civilized world.”

For Heilperin and the ICC, the ITO charter was a “dangerous document,” above all in its transposition of democracy into international relations. Speaking before the U.S. Congress, Bristol said that the “one-country-one vote voting procedure is unacceptable.” It threatened to create a situation in which “the rules of international commerce are being laid down by large numbers of countries who have a minor stake in international trade and often very little experience in conducting commercial policy.”

zh: 海尔佩林把对ITO的批评扩展到对第一次世界大战结束以来世界的一般观察。他指出，这一段历史时期以悖论为特征：对全球经济相互依存的认识在不断加深的同时，国际贸易与交换的壁垒却在不断增多。
这带来了一系列堂吉诃德式的希望，例如凯恩斯倡导、被许多人视为战后秩序核心的“隔绝”。所谓“政策自主”这一目标的实质在于：一个国家应当可以随心所欲地打破游戏规则。哈瓦那会议本意是国际主义的一场展演，结果成了“一场关于当今民族主义的极为发人深省、极具启发性的研讨会”。
在海尔佩林看来，ITO是未能认识到需要为imperium（统治权）与dominium（所有权）设置双重政府的一个醒目案例。
en: Heilperin expanded his critique of the ITO to general observations about the world since the end of the First World War. He noted that the period had been marked by a paradox: barriers to international trade and exchange multiplied even as awareness of global economic interdependence increased.

This had brought a series of quixotic hopes, such as the “insulation” promoted by Keynes and seen by many as at the heart of the postwar order. The essence of the goal of “policy autonomy” was that a nation should be free to break the rules of the game when it chose to. The Havana Conference, intended as a performance of internationalism, became a “very illuminating and enlightening seminar in present day nationalism.”
To Heilperin, the ITO was a banner case of the failure to recognize the need for a double government for imperium and dominium.

zh: 海尔佩林在另一场实业家集会上说，一个“好的”ITO将“禁止”阻挡资本和货物的一切形式，也禁止通过补贴生产以扭曲市场的更隐蔽形式。
海尔佩林给“主权”一词加上引号，暗示这个概念用于经济事务时没有内在含义。
在一篇根据其于日内瓦高等国际问题研究院演讲写成的论文中，他对“自主”也如法炮制，同样表示不认同这一概念。
按照海尔佩林的解读，行使经济主权和经济自主不仅是不明智的——而且是根本不可能的。
en: Speaking to another gathering of industrialists, Heilperin said that a “good” ITO would “prohibit” any and all forms of blocking capital and goods, as well as more subtle forms of distorting the market through subsidizing production.
Heilperin put “sovereignty” in quotation marks, implying that the term had no intrinsic meaning when applied to economic matters.
In a paper based on a lecture delivered at the Graduate Institute in Geneva, he did the same with “autonomy,” similarly discrediting the notion.
In Heilperin’s reading, exercising economic sovereignty and economic autonomy were not simply inadvisable— they were impossible.

zh: 海尔佩林以我所说的资本主义的双重世界表述了他批评的一部分。世界的一层是地球自然禀赋的层域，是生产、分配与占有的空间；另一层则是民族与国家的政治世界。主权主张的范畴错误在于断言对自然与经济世界行使政治控制。1952年，海尔佩林对此作了阐发。他说，从物理上讲，“地球是一个统一体，无法分割为等同的或自足的部分。然而在政治上，它被划分为众多彼此分立的国家，全都一心追求独立，而且往往至少追求部分的经济自给。”
地球的资源——包括气候、海洋和地核——并“不青睐我们这颗行星上盛行的那种政治划分”。他写道：“以任何方式把地球表面和全球资源摊派给各国，从而把地球的政治划分与其物理构造协调起来，是根本办不到的。出路只有一条：降低政治划分在经济关系方面的重要性。”
en: Heilperin phrased part of his critique in terms of what I have called capitalism’s double world. One stratum of the world was that of the earth’s natural endowments and the space of production, distribution, and ownership. The other stratum was the political world of nations and states. The category mistake of the sovereignty claim was to assert political control over the world of nature and economics. Heilperin elaborated on this in 1952. In physical terms, he said, “the planet is a single unit which cannot be subdivided into equivalent or self-contained parts. Politically, however, it is divided into a multitude of separate states, all bent on independence, often seeking at least partial economic self-sufficiency.”

The resources of the earth, including climates, seas, and the earth’s inner core, do “not favor the kind of political divisions which prevail on our planet.” “There is no way,” he wrote, “in which the political division of the planet can be reconciled with its physical structure by apportioning in some way or other the surface and the resources of the globe among individual states. The alternative is to reduce the importance of political divisions in terms of economic relationships.”

zh: 海尔佩林的秩序愿景既有多边性，也有单边性：它绝不容许背离自由贸易的严格律条。这不仅在于他拂去了侵犯主权的抱怨。与日内瓦学派自1930年代以来所发展的战斗性全球主义立场一脉相承，缩减主权恰恰就是要点所在。他直截了当地写道，必须把国家目标“从属”于国际秩序。
当他主张“国家边界的重要性……必须从根本上、大刀阔斧地降低”，边界必须成为“单纯的行政分界线”，各国政府必须“对其人民只拥有有限的权力”
时，他呼应了米塞斯、罗宾斯和哈耶克的联邦主义愿景。在其强版本中，这将要求他所说的“倒挡地缘政治”（geopolitics in reverse gear）：重新设计国家边界，以主动“削弱”其自给能力。
en: Heilperin’s vision of order was multilateral but also unilateral: it brooked no deviations from the strictures of free trade. It was not only that he brushed away the complaint of infringement on sovereignty. Consistent with the Geneva School position of militant globalism developed since the 1930s,
ing sovereignty was the exact point. He wrote directly that it was necessary to “subordinate” national objectives to international order.

He echoed the federalist vision of Mises, Robbins, and Hayek when he argued that “the importance of national boundaries … must be radically and drastically reduced.” They must become “mere administrative demarcation lines,” and national governments must “have only limited powers over their populations.”
In its strong form, this would require what he called “geopolitics in reverse gear,” reengineering national boundaries to actively
their capacity for self-sufficiency.

zh: 海尔佩林要求一个强有力的ITO，要求各国遵守自由贸易规则，甚至可能缩小国家的疆域，使其更加依赖世界贸易——这是战后新自由主义乌托邦被完整阐明的第一个例子。而且这一阐发是在世界上最重要的商界倡导团体内部完成的。这一方案是激进的，毫无疑问会遭到他在“资本家国际”内的雇主们拒绝。他自己也清楚，几乎不会有什么国家——包括美国——愿意签署这样的文件。有鉴于此，值得注意的是：他的行动主义连同其他新自由主义者的行动主义，在击沉ITO一事上产生了可验证的影响，这实属非凡。
en: Heilperin’s demands for a muscular ITO that would bind nations to free trade and potentially shrink them to increase dependency on world trade was the first example of a postwar neoliberal utopia being articulated in full. It was also done within the world’s most important business advocacy group. The solution was radical and no doubt would have been rejected by his employers within the “capitalist international.” He recognized that very few nations, including the United States, would be willing to sign such a document. Given this fact, it is remarkable to note the verifiable effect that his activism, along with that of fellow neoliberals, had in sinking the ITO.

zh: ICC对ITO的反对是一个意外。战争期间及战后之初，该组织曾与美国国务院关系密切。它站在国务卿科德尔·赫尔（Cordell Hull）自由贸易主张的背后，ICC美国全国理事会曾是其纲领“两党支持的基石之一”。
哈瓦那宪章付诸表决时，许多ICC成员的本能反应是延续其支持美国国务院的惯例，投下赞成票。然而，正如ICC官方史（由一位前成员撰写）所载，海尔佩林在反对阵营中找到了一个关键同盟——菲利普·科特尼，他是米塞斯的旧识，1953年加入朝圣山学社。
科特尼领导了反对派，并成功说服ICC执行委员会第一次在一个重大问题上与国务院唱反调。国际大会上一幕重演：科特尼再次领导反对ITO的阵营，对手则是有意签署协定的英国委员会。决定性时刻出现在委员会主席欧内斯特·梅西耶（Ernest Mercier）表态之际——这位法国实业家曾出席沃尔特·李普曼座谈会，也是朝圣山学社成员——他说，与其接受这项决议，他宁可递交辞呈。决议遂胎死腹中。
en: The ICC opposition to the ITO was a surprise. The organization had been close to the U.S. State Department during and immediately after the war. It stood behind Secretary of State Cordell Hull’s push for free trade, and the American Council of the ICC had been one of “the keystones of bipartisan support” for his program.

When the Havana Charter came up for a resolution, the reflexive inclination of many ICC members was to follow their pattern of support for the U.S. State Department by signing it. Yet, as the official history of the ICC (written by a former member) recounts, Heilperin found a crucial ally for his opposition in Philip Cortney, an acquaintance of Mises who joined the MPS in 1953.

Cortney led the opposition and managed to convince the ICC executive committee to oppose the State Department on a major issue for the first time. The scene repeated itself at the international meeting when Cortney again led the opposition to the ITO against the British committee, who were disposed to sign the agreement. The decisive moment came when the chairman of the committee, Ernest Mercier, a French industrialist who had attended the Walter Lippmann Colloquium and was also member of the MPS, said he would tender his resignation before accepting the resolution. The resolution died on the floor.

zh: 梅西耶与科特尼、海尔佩林站到一边，断送了ICC对ITO的支持。一位观察者把海尔佩林周围的一伙人戏称为“完美主义者”，并提出一个“有趣的可能性”：“在这个个案中，商人们才是那些‘没救的理想主义者’，而支持宪章却并不为之着迷的官僚和大学教授们反倒是‘现实主义者’。”
他在提及一份由海尔佩林执笔的声明时说：“这些声明究竟何时是在宣示乌托邦理想，何时是在描述商界集团认为真正可以达致的状态，往往不容易分辨。”
此类批评没有看出，乌托邦主义并非偶然，而是蓄意。海尔佩林1947年写道：“我们必须同意超越对现状那种贫乏而自满的合理化辩护（以所谓‘现实主义’的名义进行的那种），去追求那些在真正实现之前……看起来也许根本无法实现的目标”
海尔佩林和科特尼对哈耶克1949年的心愿可谓按字面践行：提供一个“自由主义的乌托邦……它不必过分严苛地讲求实际，也不自我局限于今天看来政治上可能的范围”。正是这些声明的过分之处，使它们与那个把论战当作手段、要让自由主义成为“一场知识冒险、一种勇气行动”的新自由主义纲领恰相契合。
换言之，观察者眼中的缺陷，或许恰恰是海尔佩林和科特尼的目标——拒绝外交辞令与实用主义，把战火烧到国家经济自主论者的阵地上。ICC的各项立场声明不只是政策文件，而是德国人所谓Kampfschriften（战斗文告）。用海尔佩林的话说，战间期世界会议的一再失败已让人吸取教训：“要抵消一股强大的潮流，就必须迎头猛击，而且下手要狠。”
en: By lining up with Cortney and Heilperin, Mercier scuttled the support of the ICC for the ITO. One observer dubbed the group around Heilperin “the perfectionists” and suggested the “interesting possibility” that “in this case the businessmen were the ‘hopeless idealists’ while the bureaucrats and college professors who supported the Charter, without being enamored of it, were the ‘realists.’ ”

Referring to a statement written by Heilperin, he said that “it is not always easy to tell when these statements are setting out utopian ideals and when they are describing a state of affairs, the business groups think is really attainable.”

Such critiques failed to see that the utopianism was not incidental but intentional. Heilperin wrote in 1947, “We must agree to go beyond barren and complacent rationalizations of the present (in the name of what is often called ‘realism’) and seek goals which may appear unattainable . . . until they have actually been reached.”

Heilperin and Cortney were fulfilling Hayek’s desire from 1949 to the letter by offering a “liberal Utopia … which is not too severely practical, and which does not confine itself to what appears today as politically possible.” It was precisely the overreach of the statements that make them amenable to the neoliberal program, which dictated polemic as a means to make liberalism “an intellectual adventure, a deed of courage.”

What observers saw as a failing, in other words, may have been exactly Heilperin and Cortney’s goal—to reject diplomacy and pragmatism and take the fight to the advocates of national economic autonomy. The ICC position statements were not just policy documents but what the Germans call

or fighting documents. As Heilperin put it, the failed world conferences of the interwar period had taught the lesson that “in order to counteract a strong trend it is necessary to hit at it and to hit hard.”

zh: 笼统而言，围绕ITO的斗争是全球北方对阵全球南方。然而，美国为促成哈瓦那宪章而公开展示的妥协姿态表明，重要的一点是：不要假定战后时刻“西方”是一个单一的、统合的行为体。

美国官方代表的立场相当灵活，战后之初他们表现出回应全球南方国家诉求的显著意愿。把美国未能批准ITO归咎于大企业不愿放弃主权，忽略了一个事实：ICC的官方立场并不是说美国参与ITO会丧失过多主权，而是说ITO对缔约国主权的侵犯还“不够”。日内瓦学派的新自由主义者把“商界国际”当作扩音器，放大一种令人想起1930年代罗宾斯和哈耶克联邦主义的激进愿景，从侧翼包抄了政府的官方立场，助推葬送了一个致力于在一定程度上保障较贫穷国家享有平等决策权的组织。
en: In broad terms, the struggle over the ITO pitted the Global North against the Global South. Yet the official U.S. display of compromise to push the Havana Charter shows that it is important not to assume that “the West” was a single unitary actor in the postwar moment.

Far from being intransigent, official U.S. representatives immediately after the war showed a remarkable willingness to respond to the demands of Global South countries. To blame the U.S. failure to ratify the ITO on the unwillingness of big business to give up its sovereignty neglects the fact that the ICC’s official position was not that the United States would lose too much sovereignty by participating in the ITO but that the ITO would not infringe

on the sovereignty of signatories. Using the “business international” as an amplifier for a radical vision reminiscent of the federalism of Robbins and Hayek from the 1930s, Geneva School neoliberals outflanked the official government position and helped doom an organization committed to a level of decision-making parity with the poorer nations of the world.

zh: 资本外逃的人权

children: THE HUMAN RIGHT OF CAPITAL FLIGHT

zh: 海尔佩林在反对ITO一事上最亲密的盟友是菲利普·科特尼，此人同时活跃于ICC美国全国理事会和全国制造商协会（NAM）。一位历史学家称科特尼为反对哈瓦那宪章的“纯粹主义者的主要代言人”。
科特尼1895年生于罗马尼亚，原名菲利普·科特纳雷亚努（Philippe Cotnareanu）；他在法国取得工程学位后移居美国，1946年入美国籍，并就任法国香水公司科蒂（Coty）总裁。科特尼曾任ICC美国理事会执行委员会成员，1957年升任主席。
他还是NAM国际关系委员会的成员——NAM是与欧洲新自由主义者关系密切的一个商界倡导团体。
该委员会的负责人是诺埃尔·萨金特（Noel Sargent），正是他于1943至1948年间雇请米塞斯担任NAM的领薪与不领薪顾问；科特尼就是在那段时期初识米塞斯的。
1949年，科特尼出版了他对ITO的批判，书名《经济慕尼黑》（The Economic Munich），把宪章与内维尔·张伯伦（Neville Chamberlain）对阿道夫·希特勒的绥靖作了论战性的类比。米塞斯盛赞此书，说它将“像科布登（Cobden）和巴斯夏（Bastiat）的著作一样，作为经济自由的经典被反复阅读”。
en: Heilperin’s closest ally in opposition to the ITO had been Philip Cortney, who was active within both the American Council of the ICC and the National Association of Manufacturers (NAM). One historian calls Cortney “the major spokesman for the purists” against the Havana Charter.

Born Philippe Cotnareanu in Romania in 1895, Cortney emigrated to the United States after taking an engineering degree in France. In 1946 he became an American citizen and president of Coty, a French perfume company. Cortney was a member of the executive committee of the U.S. Council of the ICC and would become its chairman in 1957.
He was also a member of the International Relations Committee of NAM, a business advocacy group that was close to the European neoliberals.
The committee executive was Noel Sargent, who had hired Mises to work as a paid and unpaid consultant for NAM from 1943 to 1948, when Cortney first met Mises.
In 1949 Cortney published his criticism of the ITO under the title

making a polemical analogy between the Charter and Neville Chamberlain’s appeasement of Adolf Hitler. Mises was extravagant in his praise, saying that the book would be “read and reread as a classic of economic freedom like the works of Cobden and Bastiat.”

zh: 《经济慕尼黑》最引人注目的，是它对人权话语的介入。科特尼并未全盘否定人权。他称赞联合国的《世界人权宣言》是“人类为自由与人的尊严而斗争的里程碑”。
他所不同意的是权利的选择。他谴责哈瓦那宪章把“充分就业”变成“某种神圣的人权”，并大段引用海尔佩林的蒙特勒声明加以声援。
科特尼没有把人权话语视为已被败坏而弃之不用，而是添上了自己的权利。他在一份措辞强硬的声明中提出：“和平时期的外汇管制按国际法应被视为侵略行为，也是对人权的侵犯。”
科特尼所说的外汇管制，就是通常所说的资本管制，即限制人们将一种货币兑成另一种货币，特别是出于跨境转移资金的目的进行兑换的权利。使用资本管制的权利已写进布雷顿森林的IMF框架，海尔佩林谴责这是其致命缺陷之一。尽管许多观察者认为，1920年代投机者在北大西洋两岸来回投入的“热钱”流动助推了崩盘，海尔佩林却把问题倒转过来。“‘热’的不是钱本身，”他说，“而是它逃离的地方。”
倘若取消资本管制，那些吸引到投资者的国家就必须营造出足够友好的条件，以诱导外来资本留下来。
en: was most notable for its engagement with the language of human rights. Cortney did not reject human rights as such. He praised the UN’s Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a “milestone in man’s fight for liberty and human dignity.”

It was the choice of rights he disagreed with. He condemned the way that the Havana Charter made “full employment” into a “kind of sacred human right,” quoting Heilperin’s Montreux statement at length in support.

Rather than discard the language of human rights as corrupted, Cortney added his own. In a strong statement he proposed that “exchange control in time of peace should be considered an act of aggression and a violation of human rights in international law.”

By exchange control, Cortney meant what is better known as capital controls: the right to change money from one currency to another, specifically with the goal of trans-ferring the money over a national border. The right to use capital controls was included in the framework of the IMF at Bretton Woods, a fact that Heilperin condemned as one of its crucial failings. Though many observers felt that the flow of “hot money” being invested by speculators back and forth across the Atlantic in the 1920s had helped precipitate the crash, Heilperin turned the problem around. “It is not the money that is ‘hot,’ ” he said, “but the place from which it takes flight.”
If capital controls were removed, countries that had drawn investors would have to establish conditions hospitable enough to induce foreign capital to remain.

zh: 科特尼的修辞手法是把问题从经济事务改头换面为人权问题。他把资本管制同离开一个国家的权利本身挂起钩来。他论证道：“一个人若无权带走自己的财物，离开本国的权利实际上就毫无意义”，所以在任何情形下都必须允许人们兑换并输出资本。
科特尼把移居他国的权利描述为“此人一切其他人权的基础”，指出该项权利已列入《世界人权宣言》（第十三条），同时暗示本可再进一步：将它与其必要前提——资本自由流动权——挂钩。
科特尼实际上提出的是资本外逃的人权。
en: Cortney’s rhetorical move was to reframe the question from an economic matter into a matter of human rights. He linked capital control to the right to leave a country as such. Because “the right to leave a country is for all practical purposes, meaningless unless one is entitled to take with him belongings,” he argued that one must under all circumstances be allowed to exchange and export capital.

Cortney described the right to emigrate as the “basis of all his other human rights,” noting that it is included in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (Article 13) but suggesting that this should have gone further by linking it to its necessary prerequisite: the right of free capital movement.
Cortney was effectively proposing the human right of capital flight.

zh: 在战后氛围专注于难民和寻求庇护者脱险之后的居留权的背景下，科特尼反其道而行，把资本流动作为人权的诉求与离开的权利相连，格外扎眼。他的要求既非凭空捏造，也非孤陋寡闻。科特尼是美国国际法学会的终身会员，跨国法（transnational law）奠基人之一的菲利普·杰塞普（Philip Jessup）曾援引科特尼本人的论述，说明外汇管制能够“有效地摧毁”移居他国的权利。
科特尼的独出心裁之处在于，把一项本意并非经济权利的东西读解为世界经济宪法的组成部分，认定货币是一件栖居于超乎政治管辖权之外的经济领域的财产。按他的阐释，资本需要普遍权利的庇护。与秩序全球主义（ordoglobalism）的立场一致，他呼吁把自由市场原则宪法化，要求“各国宪法应明令禁止外汇管制”。
en: In a postwar climate preoccupied with the rights of refugees and asylum seekers to stay once they had escaped danger, Cortney stood out for linking his claim of the human right of capital movement to the right to leave. His demand was neither spurious nor ill-informed. Cortney was a lifetime member of the American Society of International Law, and Philip Jessup, one of the fathers of transnational law, cited Cortney himself on the fact that exchange control can “effectively destroy” the right to emigrate.

Cortney’s ingenuity was to read what was not intended as an economic right as an aspect of the economic constitution of the world, deeming money an item of property inhabiting the economic sphere that transcends political jurisdiction. Capital requires the protection of universal rights, in his interpretation. Consistent with ordoglobalism, he called for the constitutionalization of free-market principles, demanding that “exchange controls should be outlawed in the national constitutions.”

zh: 科特尼的这一看似犬儒之举，其实与日内瓦学派新自由主义者在1945年之后数年间对人权问题的进路若合符节。新自由主义的倾向不是全盘否定人权，而是一面瓦解人权与国际法的社会民主主义阐释，一面把它们收编过来，用以涵盖明白无误的资本主义特权。无论是过去还是现在，将这种做法称为对“社会与经济权利”的批判会造成误导，因为资本、货物与劳动力的自由流动，同社会保障、就业或温饱的诉求一样，同样是社会与经济权利。诚然，正如我们将在第6章看到的，欧洲经济共同体条约所载的那些所谓市场权利，正是新自由主义欧洲愿景的核心。针对罗斯福的四大自由——言论自由、信仰自由、免于恐惧的自由、免于匮乏的自由——新自由主义者针锋相对地提出资本、货物、服务和劳动力自由流动这四项自由。
en: What seems like an act of cynicism on Cortney’s part is actually consistent with the Geneva School neoliberal approach to the question of human rights in the years after 1945. Rather than reject human rights outright, the neoliberal tendency has been to undermine social democratic interpretations of human rights and international law while simultaneously co-opting them to cover clearly capitalist prerogatives. To say this was (or is) a critique of “social and economic rights” would be misleading, because the free movement of capital, goods, and labor was just as much a social and economic right as the demand for social security, employment, or nourishment. Indeed, as we will see in Chapter 6, the so-called market rights enshrined in the European Economic Community treaty were central to the neoliberal vision of Europe. Against Roosevelt’s Four Freedoms—of speech, of worship, from fear, from want—neoliberals posed the four freedoms of capital, goods, services, and labor.

zh: 资本主义大宪章
1947年的蒙特勒会议上，海尔佩林身兼两职。一是作为ICC的代表坐在ITO谈判桌旁；二是作为ICC《保护外国投资国际法典》（International Code to Protect Foreign Investments）的主要起草人。后一份文件在科特尼的想象框架内运作，把商界诉求与权利话语捆在一起。会上，海尔佩林提出国际投资领域需要“一部公平行为准则”。
法典草案出自外国投资委员会，海尔佩林是该委员会报告员。它建立在两项先例之上：国联1929年外国人待遇会议的尝试，以及ICC1939年关于“外国公司的法律待遇”的提案。
接续战前的源头，这份提案是日后国际投资法体制的第一个版本。
en: Heilperin wore two hats at the Montreux conference in 1947. The first was as the ICC’s man at the table for the ITO negotiations. The second was as the primary author of the ICC’s International Code to Protect Foreign Investments. This latter document worked within Cortney’s imaginary by tying business demands to the language of rights. At the conference Heilperin announced the need for “a code of fair practices in the field of international investments.”

The draft code came out of the Committee on Foreign Investments, for which Heilperin was the rapporteur. It built on attempts made by the League of Nations in 1929 at a Conference on the Treatment of Foreigners and on a 1939 proposal from the ICC on the “legal treatment of foreign companies.”
Picking up on prewar roots, the proposal was the first version of what would become today’s regime of international investment law.

zh: 海尔佩林和ICC选择与联合国合作而非对抗，认为投资者权利法典应当充当《世界人权宣言》的补充。ICC要求经社理事会把法典变成一项“普遍公约”，供日后通过。
其序言很可能出自海尔佩林之手，矛头直指1947年12月联合国小组委员会提交的一份由乌拉圭提出的报告；该报告批评“外国直接投资干涉相关国家政治与经济事务的特殊危险”。
与之相反，ICC法典要求本国国民（其定义为“不仅是自然人，也包括法人或非法人社团”）享有的不是东道国法律所规定的民事权利，而是其本国法律所规定的民事权利，即便这可能赋予他们一种“优惠”地位。
海尔佩林早在1947年的书中就已指出，对外国投资者的保护必须超过对公民的保护。例如，若资本管制适用于本国公民，就不得让它适用于外侨。“平等待遇，”他说，“是不够的。”
这是对异邦人权的经典要求：外侨投资者实际享有的权利必须多于本国公民。
en: Working with rather than against the UN, Heilperin and the ICC felt that the code of investors’ rights was to act as a supplement to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The ICC tasked ECOSOC with turning the code into “a universal convention” for later adoption.

The preamble, likely written by Heilperin, took direct aim at a December 1947 report by a UN subcommission submitted by Uruguay that criticized the “special danger of direct foreign investments interfering in the political and economic affairs of those countries.”

By contrast, the ICC code called for nationals (which it defined as “not only physical persons but also incorporated or unincorporated associations”) to enjoy the civil rights not of the host state but of their own state, even if this might grant them a “preferential” position.

Heilperin had already noted in his 1947 book that the protection for foreign investors had to exceed that for citizens. If capital controls applied to citizens, for example, they must not be allowed to apply to aliens. “Equality of treatment,” he said, “does not suffice.
In a classic demand for xenos rights, the alien investor must actually have more rights than citizens.

zh: 新自由主义者和大企业在1947年聚焦投资者权利，动因在于他们认为私有财产在第二次世界大战期间和战后都失去了稳固保障。衰落始于第一次世界大战期间；正如勒普克所言，那时“无视敌方私有财产已成交战国各方的常态”。
苏联1917年之后的财产征收是一个标志性的决裂，随后是国务院一位顾问所称的“战间期这一类征收的沉闷连续剧”。
哈耶克在《通往奴役之路》中所抱怨的，正是这类征收外资财产的行为——或者，用后帝国时代中欧的叫法，把财产转给本国私人的做法，即所谓“本国化”（nostrification）。
尽管在世界范围内，此类国有化往往给外国业主支付了高于市价的补偿，观察者仍频频援引墨西哥1938年石油国有化等案例，作为财产权在全球受到侵蚀的证据。
en: focus of neoliberals and big business on investor rights in 1947 was motivated by the perceived precariousness of private property both during and after the Second World War.
decline had begun during the First World War, when, as Röpke noted, “disregard of the private property of the enemy had become the rule among the belligerents.”

Soviet Union’s expropriation of property after 1917 had been a signal rupture, followed by what a U.S. State Department adviser called a “dreary succession of such takings in the period between the wars.”
It was such acts of expropriating foreign-owned property—or what was called nostrification in postimperial Central Europe when the property was given to private nationals—that Hayek complained of in

Even though foreign owners were often compensated at above-market price for such nationalizations worldwide, observers regularly cited cases, such as the Mexican nationalization of oil in 1938, as evidence of a global erosion of property rights.

zh: 新自由主义者看到，对资本家各种名目的“外国权利”“外侨权利”的轻蔑在战后时期延续不断。点燃他们怒火的导火索有时出人意料。例如，科特尼呼吁把外汇管制定为“侵犯人权”，其直接背景是马歇尔计划框架下美国与西欧政府合作遣返被隐匿的西欧资产。科特尼说，美国这样做，是在搜查欧洲人存在美国银行账户中的资产时扮演了“盖世太保的角色”。
勒普克也以同样口径猛烈抨击二战后瑞士没收德国资产的做法，称其破坏了“战争情形下主权与财产相分离的原则”。
en: Neoliberals saw the disrespect of what were variously called “foreign rights” and “alien rights” of capitalists continuing into the postwar period. The specific sparks to their outrage were sometimes surprising. The proximate context for Cortney’s call to designate exchange control a “violation of human rights,” for example, was the cooperation of the U.S. and Western European governments to repatriate concealed Western European assets as part of the Marshall Plan. Cortney said that in doing this, the United States was assuming “the role of a Gestapo” in locating European assets in American bank accounts.

Röpke railed in a similar vein against the confiscation of German assets in Switzerland after the Second World War, saying that it undermined “the principle of the separation of sovereignty and property in the case of war.”

zh: 考虑到战争的种种恐怖，竟有知识分子把这场战争遗留的丑闻视为侵略国国民失去了自己在国外的财产，着实令人愕然。但在勒普克和科特尼看来，这些不是孤立的委屈，而是一种更大疾病的症状。日内瓦学派的新自由主义者要求一部世界经济宪法，坚持主张：治理一块领土并不意味着拥有其境内的财产。ICC及其新自由主义顾问们的运动，就是要创建一个法律框架，维护政府的imperium（统治权）与财产的dominium（所有权）之间的区分。新自由主义者向法律军械库伸手，以重建财产与领土之间的界限。
en: Considering the horrors of the war, it is startling to find an intellectual perceiving its lasting scandal as being the loss of foreign-owned property by citizens of the aggressor nation. Yet to Röpke and Cortney, these were not isolated grievances but symptoms of a larger malady. In demanding an economic constitution of the world, Geneva School neoliberals insisted that governing a territory did not mean owning the property within it. The campaign of the ICC and its neoliberal advisers was to create a legal framework to uphold the distinction between the imperium of government and the dominium of property. Neoliberals reached to the armory of law to rebuild the distinction between property and territory.

zh: ICC的提案被一个对基于民族国家的社会民主诉求比对教条的全球主义商业权利更有同情的经社理事会接了过去。在战后数十年里，联合国大会成为“对自然资源的永久国家主权”原则的“助产士”。
根据乌拉圭和玻利维亚的一项提案，联合国大会1952年通过了众多决议中的第一个，宣布“各民族自由利用和开发其自然财富与资源的权利是其主权所固有的”。
面对这种获得联合国背书的国有化潮流，德国保护外国投资协会重新搬出海尔佩林的ICC法典，作为其自己的公约草案的基础。在协会1956年成立大会上，朝圣山学社成员路德维希·艾哈德宣称：“尤其在西方世界，对私有财产的侵犯正像一种暗中蔓延的毒药，越蚀越深。”
艾哈德把财产的威胁定位于西方，符合新自由主义者的解读：全球北方的社会民主主义正与全球南方的国有化倾向里应外合，危及财产的神圣性。1957年，在一次朝圣山学社会议上，阿瑟·申菲尔德（Arthur Shenfield）说：“如果能让人们看清，只有尊重资本权利的人才可能获得西方资本，那将对潜在借款国的内部施政产生非常有益的影响。但要做到这一点，西方当然必须重新学会理解并尊重资本所有者的权利。”
en: The ICC’s proposal was taken up by an ECOSOC more sympathetic to social democratic nation-based demands than doctrinaire globalist business rights. In the postwar decades, the UN General Assembly became the “midwife” to the principle of “permanent national sovereignty over natural resources.”

After a proposal by Uruguay and Bolivia, the UN General Assembly in 1952 passed its first resolution of many declaring that “the right of peoples freely to use and exploit their natural wealth and resources is inherent in their sovereignty.”

Responding to a trend toward nationalization with UN sanction, the German Society for the Protection of Foreign Investment revived Heilperin’s ICC code as a basis for its own Draft Convention. At the Society’s inaugural meeting in 1956, MPS member Ludwig Erhard declared that “especially in the Western world, infractions against private property are eating further and further in, like a sneaking poison.”

Erhard’s placement of the danger to property in the West was consistent with the neoliberal interpretation, which held that social democracy in the Global North was working in tandem with nationalizing tendencies in the Global South to imperil the sanctity of property. At an MPS meeting in 1957, Arthur Shenfield said that “if it became clear that the capital of the West could be obtained only by those who respected the rights of capital, there would be a very salutary influence on the internal conduct of affairs in the prospective borrowing countries. But for that, of course, the West must itself learn again to understand and respect the rights of capital owners.”

zh: 1952年，米塞斯注意到南方与北方之间那种不被承认的对称性的讽刺意味，他说：“如果说英国人把英国煤矿收归国有是对的，那么伊朗人把伊朗石油工业收归国有就不可能是错的。要是艾德礼（Attlee）先生前后一致，他本来会祝贺伊朗人这一伟大的社会主义成就。”
勒普克一年之后写道：“摩萨台们（Mossadeqs）是在向艾德礼们和贝文们（Bevans）求援，而正是后者给了他们国有化的灵感。”

事实上，英国针对英伊石油公司遭征收提起的案件，是向国际商界传递的最重要信号之一：为更有力地保护外国财产，新的标准势在必行。德国保护外国投资协会主席、德意志银行掌门人赫尔曼·约瑟夫·阿布斯（Hermann Josef Abs）——此人在第三帝国期间曾督导对犹太人财产征收——在1950年代后半叶成了财产权的国际代言人。协会起草《相互保护外国私人财产权国际公约》（International Convention for the Mutual Protection of Private Property Rights in Foreign Countries）之后，阿布斯1956年在美国国际法学会陈述其主张，并在1957年10月15日国际工业发展大会旧金山演讲中作了最有影响的阐发；他在演讲中援引了ICC的声明。这篇题为“资本的安全”（The Safety of Capital）的演说被《时代》（
）周刊以“一部资本主义大宪章”为标题报道，而该期封面人物正是路德维希·艾哈德。
en: In 1952 Mises observed the irony of the disavowed symmetry between Global South and North when he said, “If it is right for the British to nationalize the British coal mines, it cannot be wrong for the Iranians to nationalize the Iranian oil industry. If Mr. Attlee were consistent, he would have congratulated the Iranians on their great socialist achievement.”
Röpke wrote a year later that “the Mossadeqs appeal to the Atlees and the Bevans, who have inspired them with the idea of nationalization.”

In fact, the British case against the expropriation of Anglo-Iranian Oil was one of the most important signals to the international business community that new standards were necessary for more robust protection of foreign property. The German Society’s president, the Deutsche Bank head Hermann Josef Abs, who had overseen the expropriation of Jewish property in the Third Reich, became an international spokesperson for property rights in the second half of the 1950s. After the Society drafted an “International Convention for the Mutual Protection of Private Property Rights in Foreign Countries,” Abs made his case before the American Society of International Law in 1956 and, most influentially, in a San Francisco speech at the International Industrial Development Conference on October 15, 1957, in which he cited the ICC statement. The speech, titled “The Safety of Capital,” was reported in
magazine under the headline “A Capitalist Magna Carta” in an issue that featured Ludwig Erhard on its cover.

zh: 阿布斯的主张开启了一场关于投资者权利的国际对话。
他的“资本主义大宪章”将要求签署方不得对“外国资本”作“直接或间接的非法干预”，并设立一个国际仲裁法庭裁判违规行为。投资者可以先求助于这个第三方法庭，而不必诉诸当地法院。
为强调其法典的迫切需要，阿布斯列举了近来的几桩案件：英伊石油公司被征收、联合果品公司在危地马拉的产业被征收、苏伊士运河、荷兰在印尼的土地、阿根廷的外资发电厂。
与ICC一样，在阿布斯看来，联合国已经站到了财产劫掠者一边，成了他们的帮凶，因为它通过了支持“征收随时可以为之且无需补偿”这一理念的决议。
en: Abs’s proposal opened an international conversation on the rights of the investor.

His “capitalist Magna Carta” would oblige signees to abstain from “direct or indirect illegal interference” with “foreign capital” and would create an International Court of Arbitration to judge violations. Investors could turn to the third-party court first, without using local courts.

To punctuate the need for his code, Abs brought up the recent cases of the expropriation of the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, the United Fruit Company in Guatemala, the Suez Canal, Dutch land in Indonesia, and foreign-owned power plants in Argentina.
For Abs, like the ICC, the UN had become an enemy accomplice of the property thieves, passing resolutions supporting the idea that “expropriations are permissible at any time without compensation.”

zh: 一个曾积极参与处理德国犹太人财产征收的人，日后竟积极捍卫财产，这格格不入，但阿布斯既不是出于失忆，也不是出于忏悔。在旧金山演讲中，他特意提出科特尼和勒普克耿耿于怀的问题：在德国银行开户的外国人“至今仍在等待公正的了结”。
阿布斯就是1953年签署文件豁免德国巨额战争债务的那个人；众所周知，他签署时相信这与其说是宽免，不如说是对在海外被没收的德国资产的公正清算。阿布斯的投资保护运动，是那份执着承诺的延续——坚持用经济宪法把国家的公共世界与财产的私人世界分开。他的原始方案中有一部分——被一位观察者称为“理想主义”——将使外侨财产在战争时期也不受没收。
en: That an individual who had been an active participant in processing the expropriation of the property of German Jews would later be actively defending property was incongruous, but Abs did not act from amnesia or repentance. In his San Francisco speech he made a point of raising Cortney and Röpke’s bugbear issue of foreign holders of accounts of German banks who were “still waiting for a fair settlement.”

Abs was the man who signed the document forgiving Germany’s massive war debt in 1953, and it is known that he did so in the belief that it was not forgiveness per se but instead a just settling of accounts for the German assets seized abroad. Abs’s campaign for investor protection was a continuation of the dogged commitment to the economic constitution dividing the public world of states from the private world of property. Part of his original proposal, described by an observer as “idealistic,” would have made alien property immune from confiscation during times of war.

zh: 资本主义大宪章在美国引起兴趣。来自纽约的司法委员会主席埃马纽埃尔·塞勒（Emmanuel Celler）宣称阿布斯大宪章的紧迫性，描述了一座矗立于墨西哥城大道、纪念石油国有化的纪念碑，并阴森地谈起印度尼西亚盛行的“丛林法则”，那里荷兰资产被“一心复仇的野人”征收。
他说：“如果西德能在阿布斯和艾哈德的领导下，为创制这样一部大宪章蹚出一条路，那将确实是了不起的成就。”
到1950年代末，反对征收的斗争开始带上种族化的语言：以法治对抗丛林法则，把理性的西方对立之以“情绪化”方式执着于主权的全球南方。
en: The capitalist Magna Carta drew interest in the United States. The chair of the judiciary committee of New York, Emmanuel Celler, declared the urgency of Abs’s Magna Carta as he described a monument on a Mexico City boulevard commemorating the nationalization of oil and spoke balefully of “the law of the jungle” prevailing in Indonesia, where Dutch assets were expropriated by “wild men bent upon revenge.”
“It would indeed be a great achievement,” he said, “if West Germany could blaze a trail to the creation of such a Magna Carta under the leadership of Abs and Erhard.”

By the late 1950s the struggle against expropriation was taking on a racialized language of the rule of law against the rule of the jungle, pitting the rational West against a Global South, with its “emotional” commitment to sovereignty.

zh: 哈特利·肖克罗斯爵士（Sir Hartley Shawcross）领导的一批英国律师与阿布斯合作，于1959年将一份《国外投资公约草案》（Draft Convention on Investments Abroad）分发征求意见。这份文件通篇关注的是“本国国民”财产的保护；而按照定义——沿袭ICC法典——“本国国民”不是个人，而是“公司”，即“既包括依缔约一方法律被承认为法人者，也包括纵不具备法律人格的社团”。
对公约发表评论的法律专家并未给出乐观评价。一位专家指出，公约序言自称是“原则的重述”，但“在若干方面，它显然远不止于此”。
他们认为，公约给予外国投资者的保护前所未有。
在每一处，公约都偏向投资者：它拒斥以“公共利益”作为征收理由；允许投资者先诉诸国际法院而非国内法院；打破现行惯例，强制要求补偿以投资者本国货币支付，并把保护的首要对象定位于公司而非个人。
en: Combined with the work of a group of British attorneys under Sir Hartley Shawcross, Abs circulated a “Draft Convention on Investments Abroad” for comment in 1959. The document was concerned entirely with the protection of the property of “nationals,” which were defined not as individuals but (following the ICC code) as “companies,” including “both juridical persons recognized as such by the law of a Party and associations even if they do not possess legal personality.”

The legal experts who commented on the convention were not encouraging. The preamble of the convention presented itself as a “restatement of principles,” one expert noted, but “in several respects, it is clearly a good deal more than that.”
They saw the convention as unprecedented in the protection it gave the foreign investor.

In every instance, it tipped toward the investor, dismissing “public interest” as a reason for expropriation, allowing investors to turn to an international court before national courts, and breaking with current practice by forcing compensation to be made in the investor’s own currency and making the primary object of protection the company rather than the individual.

zh: 《阿布斯-肖克罗斯公约》同时提及“直接”征收与“间接”征收，甚至预示了后来国际法典中纳入“管制性征收”。一位同时代的批评者指出：“很难界定间接剥夺财产止于何处，而例如税收、规划立法或财产法改革又始于何处。”
国务院一位前法律顾问最尖锐地点出了公约的严重失衡。他怀疑，这项主张难道不是“要让一国作出承诺：为了以支付外汇的方式补偿其行使征用权所征收的财产，它必须准备从本国人民口中夺食”吗？他问道，这难道不等同于“一场把‘财产权’凌驾于果腹这一‘人权’之上的努力”吗？
en: By referring to both “direct” and “indirect” expropriation, the Abs-Shawcross convention even anticipated the later inclusion of “regulatory expropriation” in international codes. One contemporary critic noted, “It is difficult to determine where indirect deprivation of property ends and, for instance, taxation, planning legislation, or property law reform begins.”

A former legal adviser to the State Department most sharply pointed out the lopsidedness of the convention. He wondered whether the proposition was not “to secure a commitment from a country that it must be prepared to take food from the mouth of its people in order to pay compensation in foreign exchange for property taken in exercise of its eminent domain power.” He asked if this would amount to “an effort to erect ‘property rights’ over the ‘human right’ to eat.”

zh: 一位律师指出，美国仅仅与少数几个全球南方国家缔结了“打了折扣的”商业投资保护条约，而对非殖民化不久的国家或作为外国资本主要目的地的南美国家，则完全没有成功——可见这样的公约离现实有多远。

一种解读可以是：与ICC法典一样，《阿布斯-肖克罗斯公约》并非认真的提案。它是一份论战文件，描绘了一个梦想世界：其中资本不仅在全球无阻流动，而且由资本输出国政府和超国家的第三方仲裁机构共同在全球层面加以围封。可以肯定的是，二者都不是试图同发展中国家相互让步的方案；毋宁说，它们是掷向全球南方的战书。颇具症候意义的是——正如批评者指出的——ICC法典和《阿布斯-肖克罗斯公约》都没有提及来自全球南方的投资保护提案，尤其是马来亚的一份提案，后者寻求平衡资本输入国与输出国双方需求。
这些法典本身就是写进条文的含蓄威胁（coded threats），旨在约束其作者和鼓吹者眼中第三世界的越轨之举。
en: Demonstrating how far such a convention was from reality, one lawyer noted that the United States had been able to secure only “watered-down” commercial investment-protection treaties with a handful of Global South countries, and had no success at all with either recently decolonized nations or South American nations, which were major destinations for foreign capital.

One interpretation could be that the Abs-Shawcross convention, like the ICC Code, was not a serious proposal. It was a polemical document, outlining a dream world in which capital not only moved unobstructed globally but was encased globally by both home states and supranational third-party institutions of arbitration. What is clear is that neither of them were attempts to meet developing nations halfway. Rather, they were gauntlets thrown down to the Global South. It is symptomatic, as critics noted, that neither the ICC nor the Abs-Shawcross convention even acknowledged investment protection proposals coming from the Global South, including one in particular from Malaya, that sought to balance the needs of capital-importing and exporting countries.
The codes were coded threats of their own, seeking to discipline what their authors and champions saw as Third World overreach.

children: 〔编者注〕断词修正：watereddown→watered-down（only “watered- / down” commercial investment-protection treaties）
〔编者注〕断词修正：watereddown→watered-down（only “watered- / down” commercial investment-protection treaties）

zh: 双边解决方案
考虑到拟议中的国际投资法典的乌托邦性质，这些法典竟随时间的推移成为现实，这一认识令人震惊，也印证了全球南方谈判权力的长期溃败。现代国际投资条约如今大体与《阿布斯—肖克罗斯草案》相似。
不过，海尔佩林的设计与后来实际生效的制度之间有一大差别：从多边进路改弦更张为双边进路。1958年，美国众议员、ITO首席谈判代表之一詹姆斯·G. 富尔顿（James G. Fulton，共和党、宾夕法尼亚州）称赞资本主义大宪章的构想，但承认世界宪章一事已表明要求各国共同接受一套规则有多难。他建议不妨改用双边条约。
ICC从一开始就表示普遍性法典更可取，但其文件同样可以充作双边关系的基础。
事实上，蒙特勒大会还依照战间期的模板，产出了一份双边协定范本。
海尔佩林本人也承认，就“恢复世界经济昔日健康”的问题而言，“‘普世进路’已经失败”。
1952年，他1947年的著作《诸国贸易》（
）出第二版时，他表示数年间自己的看法已转向肯定双边条约的优长。国与国之间的条约确实是远为通行的常态，包括美国直到1980年代仍在沿用的通商航海自由条约。
en: Given the utopian nature of the proposed international investment codes, it is a startling recognition of the long-term defeat of the bargaining power of the Global South that those codes have become reality over time. Modern international investment treaties now largely resemble the Abs-Shawcross “Draft.”

A major difference between Heilperin’s proposals and what later came into effect, however, was the switch from the mulitilateral to the bilateral approach. In 1958 U.S. representative James G. Fulton (R-PA), one of the chief negotiators for the ITO, praised the idea of the capitalist Magna Carta but conceded that the world charter had shown the difficulty of the universal demand. He suggested that bilateral treaties might be used instead.
From the beginning the ICC had indicated that a universal code was preferable, but their document would also work as the basis for bilateral relationships.
In fact, the Montreux Congress had also produced a Model Bilateral Agreement drawing on interwar templates.
Heilperin himself announced the failure of the “ ‘universalist approach’ to the problems of restoring the world economy to its former health.”
When a second edition of his 1947 book

came out in 1952, he stated that his opinion had moved in the intervening years to the quality of the bilateral treaty. State-to-state treaties were indeed much more the norm, including the Freedom of Commerce and Navigation treaties that the U.S. used up until the 1980s.

zh: 双边投资条约（BIT）最终成为投资者权利从乌托邦走向现实所经的通道。这里同样有一段朝圣山学社的故事。1959年，《纽约时报》（
）报道，巴基斯坦“启动了一项由促成西德非凡战后复兴的谋士们设计的激进经济复兴计划”。西德经济部长、朝圣山学社成员路德维希·艾哈德于1958年底访问巴基斯坦；穆罕默德·阿尤布·汗（Muhammad Ayub Khan）将军政变上台后，“全盘”采纳了他的政策建议。建议内容是：叫停国家的工业化运动，转向农业，启动一场食品作物的“全力出口攻势”。
1959年，另一位朝圣山学社成员埃贡·佐门（Egon Sohmen）在美国一流的经济学期刊上谈到巴基斯坦“沿着新自由主义路线对其发展计划进行的彻底重估”。
这一策略与朝圣山学社内部的发展论述一脉相承：该论述警告边缘地区可能出现“过度工业化”，鼓励全球南方通过农业生产安守其在国际分工中的位置。
en: The Bilateral Investment Treaty ended up offering the path that investor rights took from utopia to reality. Here, too, there was an MPS story. In 1959 the

reported that Pakistan had “embarked upon a radical program of economic rehabilitation charted by the men behind West Germany’s remarkable postwar recovery.” Ludwig Erhard, economics minister for West Germany and MPS member, visited Pakistan in late 1958, and his policy advice was adopted “in toto” by General Mohammad Ayub Khan after his seizure of power in a coup. The advice was to halt the country’s industrialization campaign and to focus on agriculture to start an “all out export drive” on food crops.
In 1959 Egon Sohmen, another MPS member, referred in the leading American economics journal to Pakistan’s “thoroughgoing reappraisal of its development planning along neoliberal lines.”

The strategy was consistent with the development discourse in the MPS, which criticized a potential “overindustrialization” of the periphery and encouraged the Global South to keep its place in the international division of labor through agricultural production.

zh: 巴基斯坦改革的组成部分之一，是签署了一份日后成为所有双边投资条约模板的条约。这份《促进与保护投资条约》（Treaty for the Promotion and Protection of Investments）由西德和巴基斯坦两国政府于1959年11月签署，艾哈德于1961年提交联邦议院（Bundestag）。
条约径直采借ICC法典和《阿布斯-肖克罗斯草案》的措辞，包括外侨以本国货币获取补偿的条款，以及将“本国国民”扩定义至“任何其他公司或社团，无论是否具备法律人格”的规定。

多边方案未能奏效，双边方案却成功了，把貌似激进的国际投资者保护条件带进了有约束力的法律。哈耶克有一部著作开篇把法律比作一把小刀。他写道：“正如一个人动身徒步旅行时会随身携带他的折叠小刀，不是为了某个预见到的特定用途，而是为了应付各种可能发生的意外、能够应对在我们的世界里很可能出现的那类情形；一个群体发展出的行为规则，同样不是为已知特定目的而设的手段，而是对既往经验表明会在我们所处的这类世界中反复出现的那类情形的适应。”
1945年之后的岁月里，新自由主义者拿起了法律这把刀，指望它为市场提供框架。他们不得不这样做，其缘由与哈耶克终其一生对法律抱持日益增长的信心相同：民主的恣意行使及其地理上的扩张，正在侵蚀区分政治与经济的诸原则。
en: Part of Pakistan’s reform was the signing of what became the template for all future bilateral investment treaties. Signed by the West German and Pakistani governments in November 1959, Erhard submitted the “Treaty for the Promotion and Protection of Investments” to the Bundestag in 1961.

The treaty took language straight from the ICC Code and the Abs-Shawcross Draft, including the provision on compensation in the alien’s home currency and the expanded definition of “nationals” to include “any other company or association, with or without legal personality.”

Where the universal approach had failed, the particular approach succeeded, bringing the seemingly radical conditions of international investor protection into binding law. Hayek began one of his books by comparing the law to a knife. “Just as a man, setting out on a walking tour, will take his pocketknife with him, not for a particular foreseen use but in order to be equipped for various possible contingencies, or to be able to cope with kinds of situations likely to occur,” he wrote, “so the rules of conduct developed by a group are not means for known particular purposes but adaptations to kinds of situations which past experience has shown to recur in the kind of world we live in.”

Neoliberals took up the knife of the law in the years after 1945, relying on it to provide a framework for the market. They were compelled to do so for the same reason Hayek, over his lifetime, put increasing faith in the law: the reckless exercise and geographical expansion of democracy was corroding the principles separating politics from economics.

zh: 在非殖民化时代，新自由主义者把以一国一票原则为基础的国际组织视为世界经济秩序的敌人。它们不适合作为哈耶克所说的那种拥有说“不”之权的国际权力机构。1930年代全球主义的日内瓦，对新自由主义者而言是一座失落的伊甸园。1960年，海尔佩林缅怀国联，说它“受自由主义哲学的指引”，“尽其所能促进更自由的贸易与支付以及国与国之间稳定货币关系的复兴”。战后时代带来的却是“联合国——它在很大程度上恰恰相反”，这个组织“迄今证明，在帮助重建一个行得通的国际经济方面异常无能”。

在许多方面，新自由主义者仍是国联这项已然失败的事业的拥护者（lost causers），把日内瓦机构捧作国际组织的更佳版本。日内瓦学派的新自由主义者痛斥联合国，不是因为它搞世界政府，而是因为它是错误种类的世界政府。具有讽刺意味的是，这个伊甸园般的国联，正如他们伊甸园般的哈布斯堡帝国，在很大程度是一种幻想，是他们自家理论一厢情愿的构拟。事实上，到1945年，国联已成为在全球层面推行扩张性政策的主要倡导者。
en: In the age of decolonization, neoliberals saw international organizations based on the one-nation-one-vote principle as the enemies of world economic order. They were unsuitable candidates for what Hayek called an international power with the authority to say no. The globalist Geneva of the 1930s was a lost Eden for neoliberals. In 1960 Heilperin pined for the League, “inspired by the philosophy of liberalism,” which “did all in its power to promote the revival of freer trade and payments and of stable currency relations between nations.” The postwar era brought “the United Nations, of which the opposite is largely true,” an organization that “has so far proved singularly ineffective in helping rebuild a workable international economy.”

In many ways neoliberals were League of Nations “lost causers,” with the Genevan institution held up as the better version of international organization. Geneva School neoliberals railed against the UN not because it was world government but because it was the wrong kind of world government. It is an irony that this Edenic League, like their Edenic Habsburg Empire, was largely a fantasy, a wishful construct of their own theories. In fact, by 1945 the League had become a leading proponent for expansionary policy at a global level.

zh: 关于新自由主义的一个持续争论在于：它究竟是恢复阶级权力的规划，还是一套融贯的意识形态。我们已经看到，它两者皆是。1945年之后，新自由主义者与国际商会并肩协作，捍卫一个特定阶级受到威胁的特权。然而，他们的想象力超出了其伙伴的想象力。他们的激进主义始终蕴含着自行生长、独立成事的可能。尽管他们同立足国际主义（internationalism）的组织合作，新自由主义者的全球主义（
）往往趋向一个未必为其东道主（及资助者）所同意的目标。
en: One of the continuing questions regarding neoliberalism is whether it is a project to restore class power or a coherent ideology. We have seen that it was both. In the years after 1945, neoliberals worked with and alongside the International Chamber of Commerce to defend the threatened privileges of a specific class. Their imagination, however, exceeded that of their partners. Their radicalism always bore the potential of taking on a life of its own. Even though they worked with organizations grounded in
the
of the neoliberals often tended toward a goal that their hosts (and funders) did not necessarily share.

zh: 1945年之后的岁月里，当新自由主义者提出一个将约束国家主权、使投资者权利高于公民权利的“好”ITO时，他们被斥为恐龙或空想家。然而，1950年代的同时代人谴责为“十九世纪主义的谬误”——以为时钟可以拨回更早的时代——的东西，已成为二十一世纪现实的一部分。
1990年代，以西德与巴基斯坦最初条约为基础的双边投资条约数量增至原来的五倍，接近2000项。
这些条约和机构将力求把一位学者所称的、建立在“人权即商业权利”原则之上的“资本主义的宪法保护”确立下来。
学者们把1970年代看作“资本的人权”取得突破的时期。
而如本章所示，这场运动还有更早的历史。
en: When in the years after 1945 neoliberals proposed a “good” ITO that would constrain national sovereignty and make investor rights stronger than civil rights, they were dismissed as dinosaurs or dreamers. Yet what was condemned by contemporaries in the 1950s as a “fallacy of nineteenth-centuryism”—believing the clock could be turned back to an earlier era—has become part of twenty-first-century reality.
In the 1990s the number of bilateral investment treaties, based on the original one between West Germany and Pakistan, quintupled to nearly 2,000.
These treaties and bodies would seek to enshrine what one scholar calls the “constitutional protection of capitalism” on the principle of “human rights as business rights.”
Scholars see the 1970s as a time of the breakthrough of “the human rights of capital.”
As we have seen here, that movement has an earlier history.

zh: 为投资者权利辩护，是新自由主义知识分子早期的一场重要战斗；他们与自1920年代起便与之合作的国际商会一道参与了这场斗争。尽管他们的运动以捍卫财产权神圣为名，更准确地说，它是一场捍卫资本流动神圣的战斗。他们为之奋斗的不是拥有与留下的权利，而是出卖与离去的权利。第二次世界大战之后，当国际法为应对无国籍者和难民问题而被重新审视之际，国际经济法也在被创制出来，以保护一位同时代人所说的“难民资金”（refugee money）的权利——资本外逃的人权。
如果说，正如历史学家所论，1940年代没有人认为人权应当以牺牲国家主权为代价加以执行，那么值得注意的是，许多人恰恰相信资本的私人权利应当以这种方式获得执行。尽管国际投资法的实际运作远非顺畅无碍，但其战后的起源故事提供了一个切题的案例，表明新自由主义者为围封世界经济而积极开展的政治行动。
en: Defending the rights of the investor was an important early fight for neoliberal intellectuals and one they engaged in with their partners from the 1920s of the ICC. Although their campaign was framed as one for the sanctity of property rights, it is more accurately a fight for the sanctity of capital mobility. They were fighting, not for the right to own and stay, but for the right to sell and leave. In the aftermath of the Second World War, as international law was being rethought to accommodate the problem of the stateless and the refugee, international economic law was being formulated to protect the rights of what one contemporary called “refugee money” and the human right of capital flight.

If, as historians argue, nobody believed that the human rights of the 1940s should be enforceable at the cost of state sovereignty, it is notable that many believed that the private rights of capital should be enforceable in exactly that way. Although the actual practice of international investment law has been far from seamless, its postwar origin story provides a pointed case of the political activism of neoliberals in their quest to encase the world economy.
